verses.original: הָאָ֜רֶץ וּבְהַפִּֽילְכֶ֨ם אֶת־ בְּנַחֲלָ֗ה תָּרִימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַיהוָ֥ה׀ קֹדֶשׁ֮ מִן־ הָאָרֶץ֒ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ אֹ֗רֶךְ עֲשָׂ֣רָה אָ֑לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב ה֥וּא בְכָל־ גְּבוּלָ֖הּ סָבִֽיב׃ קֹדֶשׁ־
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇə·hap·pî·lə·ḵem ’eṯ- bə·na·ḥă·lāh tā·rî·mū ṯə·rū·māh Yah·weh qō·ḏeš min- hā·’ā·reṣ ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’ō·reḵ ’ō·reḵ ‘ă·śā·rāh ’ā·lep̄ wə·rō·ḥaḇ hū ḇə·ḵāl- gə·ḇū·lāh sā·ḇîḇ qō·ḏeš-
verses.literal: When you divide the land by lot - as an inheritance you are to set aside a portion for the LORD a holy portion of the land 25,000 [cubits] . . . . . . . . . long and 20,000 [cubits] . . . wide This entire tract of land . . . will be holy

verses.original: מִזֶּה֙ יִהְיֶ֤ה אֶל־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת בַּחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת מְרֻבָּ֣ע וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה סָבִ֑יב מִגְרָ֥שׁ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: miz·zeh yih·yeh ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ba·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ mə·rub·bā‘ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh sā·ḇîḇ miḡ·rāš lōw sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Within this area there is to be a section for the sanctuary 500 [cubits] . . . square with 50 cubits around it for open land

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַזֹּאת֙ הַמִּדָּ֤ה תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּבֽוֹ־ יִהְיֶ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קָדָשִֽׁים׃ קֹ֥דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: ū·min- haz·zōṯ ham·mid·dāh tā·mō·wḏ ’ō·reḵ ḥă·mēš wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ wə·rō·ḥaḇ ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·ḇōw- yih·yeh ham·miq·dāš qā·ḏā·šîm qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: From this holy portion you are to measure off a length of 25,000 [cubits] . . . . . . and a width of 10,000 [cubits] . . . and in it will be the sanctuary the Most Holy [Place]

verses.original: יִֽהְיֶ֔ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ מִן־ הָאָ֜רֶץ ה֗וּא לַכֹּ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֤י הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַקְּרֵבִ֖ים לְשָׁרֵ֣ת אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֨ה מָקוֹם֙ לָהֶ֤ם לְבָ֣תִּ֔ים וּמִקְדָּ֖שׁ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yeh qō·ḏeš min- hā·’ā·reṣ hū lak·kō·hă·nîm mə·šā·rə·ṯê ham·miq·dāš haq·qə·rê·ḇîm lə·šā·rêṯ ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh mā·qō·wm lā·hem lə·ḇāt·tîm ū·miq·dāš lam·miq·dāš
verses.literal: It will be a holy portion of the land . . . to be used by the priests who minister in the sanctuary who draw near to minister before - the LORD It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy area for the sanctuary

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רֹ֑חַב יִהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם֩ מְשָׁרְתֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת לָהֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים לְשָׁכֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’ō·reḵ wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm rō·ḥaḇ yih·yɛh lal·wî·yim mə·šā·rə·ṯê hab·ba·yiṯ lā·hem la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh ‘eś·rîm lə·šā·ḵōṯ
verses.literal: [An adjacent area] 25,000 [cubits] . . . . . . long and 10,000 [cubits] . . . wide shall belong to the Levites who minister in the temple . . . it will be their possession for towns in which to live . . .

verses.original: וַאֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָעִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְאֹ֗רֶךְ לְעֻמַּ֖ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יִהְיֶֽה׃ לְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·‘îr tit·tə·nū ḥă·mê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm rō·ḥaḇ ḥă·miš·šāh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ō·reḵ lə·‘um·maṯ haq·qō·ḏeš tə·rū·maṯ yih·yeh lə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As the property of the city you are to set aside [an area] 5,000 [cubits] . . . wide and 25,000 [cubits] . . . . . . long adjacent to the holy district It will belong to the whole house of Israel

verses.original: וְלַנָּשִׂ֡יא מִזֶּ֣ה פְּנֵ֤י וּמִזֶּה֩ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ לִתְרוּמַ֨ת וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֗יר אֶל־ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ תְרֽוּמַת־ וְאֶל־ פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּה מִפְּאַת־ קָדִ֑ימָה קֵ֖דְמָה וּמִפְּאַת־ וְאֹ֗רֶךְ יָ֖ם אֶל־ מִגְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָה׃ גְּב֥וּל לְעֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַחֲלָקִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: wə·lan·nā·śî miz·zeh pə·nê ū·miz·zeh haq·qō·ḏeš liṯ·rū·maṯ wə·la·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·‘îr ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš ṯə·rū·maṯ- wə·’el- pə·nê ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·‘îr yām yām·māh mip·pə·’aṯ- qā·ḏî·māh qê·ḏə·māh ū·mip·pə·’aṯ- wə·’ō·reḵ yām ’el- mig·gə·ḇūl qā·ḏî·māh gə·ḇūl lə·‘um·mō·wṯ ’a·ḥaḏ ha·ḥă·lā·qîm
verses.literal: Now the prince will have the area bordering each side of the area formed by - - . . . - the holy district - - and the property of the city extending westward from the western side and eastward from the eastern side running lengthwise from the western . . . boundary to the eastern boundary and parallel to one of the [tribal] portions

verses.original: לָאָ֛רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֥וֹ לַֽאֲחֻזָּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נְשִׂיאַי֙ אֶת־ וְלֹא־ ע֤וֹד יוֹנ֨וּ עַמִּ֔י יִתְּנ֥וּ וְהָאָ֛רֶץ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·’ā·reṣ yih·yeh- lōw la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl nə·śî·’ay ’eṯ- wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ yō·w·nū ‘am·mî yit·tə·nū wə·hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·šiḇ·ṭê·hem
verses.literal: This land will be his possession in Israel And My princes - will no longer oppress My people but will give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אָמַ֞ר רַב־ לָכֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָסִ֔ירוּ חָמָ֤ס וָשֹׁד֙ עֲשׂ֑וּ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה הָרִ֤ימוּ גְרֻשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל עַמִּ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar raḇ- lā·ḵem nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl hā·sî·rū ḥā·mās wā·šōḏ ‘ă·śū ū·miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh hā·rî·mū ḡə·ru·šō·ṯê·ḵem mê·‘al ‘am·mî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Enough O princes of Israel Cease your violence and oppression and do what is just and right Stop dispossessing . . . My people declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: יְהִ֥י לָכֶֽם׃ צֶ֧דֶק מֹֽאזְנֵי־ צֶ֛דֶק וְאֵֽיפַת־ צֶ֖דֶק וּבַת־
verses.transliteration: yə·hî lā·ḵem ṣe·ḏeq mō·zə·nê- ṣe·ḏeq wə·’ê·p̄aṯ- ṣe·ḏeq ū·ḇaṯ-
verses.literal: You must use honest scales a just ephah and a just bath

verses.original: הָאֵיפָ֣ה וְהַבַּ֗ת יִֽהְיֶ֔ה אֶחָד֙ תֹּ֤כֶן הַבָּ֑ת לָשֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַחֹ֖מֶר הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ אֶל־ הַחֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ê·p̄āh wə·hab·baṯ yih·yeh ’e·ḥāḏ tō·ḵen hab·bāṯ lā·śêṯ ma‘·śar ha·ḥō·mer hā·’ê·p̄āh wa·‘ă·śî·riṯ ha·ḥō·mer ’el- ha·ḥō·mer yih·yeh maṯ·kun·tōw
verses.literal: The ephah and the bath shall be the same quantity so that the bath will contain a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer - the homer will be the standard measure [for both]

verses.original: וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֣ים גֵּרָ֑ה עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שְׁקָלִ֜ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה שְׁקָלִ֗ים עֲשָׂרָ֤ה וַחֲמִשָּׁה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶל יִֽהְיֶ֥ה הַמָּנֶ֖ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·še·qel ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh ‘eś·rîm šə·qā·lîm wə·‘eś·rîm ḥă·miš·šāh šə·qā·lîm ‘ă·śā·rāh wa·ḥă·miš·šāh še·qel yih·yeh ham·mā·neh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The shekel will consist of twenty gerahs Twenty shekels plus twenty-five . . . shekels plus fifteen . . . shekels will equal one mina

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַתְּרוּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֑ימוּ שִׁשִּׁ֤ית הָֽאֵיפָה֙ מֵחֹ֣מֶר הַֽחִטִּ֔ים וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם֙ הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה מֵחֹ֖מֶר הַשְּׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hat·tə·rū·māh ’ă·šer tā·rî·mū šiš·šîṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh mê·ḥō·mer ha·ḥiṭ·ṭîm wə·šiš·šî·ṯem hā·’ê·p̄āh mê·ḥō·mer haś·śə·‘ō·rîm
verses.literal: This is the contribution - you are to offer a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley

verses.original: וְחֹ֨ק הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן הַבַּ֣ת הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַבַּת֙ מִן־ הַכֹּ֔ר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹ֑מֶר כִּֽי־ עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥōq haš·še·men hab·baṯ haš·še·men ma‘·śar hab·baṯ min- hak·kōr ‘ă·śe·reṯ hab·bat·tîm ḥō·mer kî- ‘ă·śe·reṯ hab·bat·tîm ḥō·mer
verses.literal: The prescribed portion of oil measured by the bath . . . [is] a tenth of a bath from each cor [a cor consists of] ten baths [or] one homer since ten baths [are equivalent to] a homer

verses.original: מִן־ אַחַ֨ת וְשֶׂה־ הַצֹּ֤אן מִן־ הַמָּאתַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּשְׁקֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִנְחָ֖ה וּלְעוֹלָ֣ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: min- ’a·ḥaṯ wə·śeh- haṣ·ṣōn min- ham·mā·ṯa·yim mim·maš·qêh yiś·rā·’êl lə·min·ḥāh ū·lə·‘ō·w·lāh wə·liš·lā·mîm lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·hem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And one sheep shall be given from [each] flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel These are for the grain offerings burnt offerings and peace offerings to make atonement for the people declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הָעָ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ יִהְי֖וּ אֶל־ הַזֹּ֑את הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה לַנָּשִׂ֖יא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōl hā·‘ām hā·’ā·reṣ yih·yū ’el- haz·zōṯ hat·tə·rū·māh lan·nā·śî bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: All the people of the land must participate in this contribution for the prince in Israel

verses.original: וְעַֽל־ יִהְיֶ֗ה הַנָּשִׂ֣יא הָעוֹל֣וֹת וְהַמִּנְחָה֮ וְהַנֵּסֶךְ֒ בַּחַגִּ֤ים וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים֙ וּבַשַּׁבָּת֔וֹת בְּכָֽל־ מוֹעֲדֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֽוּא־ יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֶת־ הַחַטָּ֣את וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה וְאֶת־ הָֽעוֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים לְכַפֵּ֖ר בְּעַ֥ד בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yih·yeh han·nā·śî hā·‘ō·w·lō·wṯ wə·ham·min·ḥāh wə·han·nê·seḵ ba·ḥag·gîm ū·ḇe·ḥo·ḏā·šîm ū·ḇaš·šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ bə·ḵāl mō·w·‘ă·ḏê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hū- ya·‘ă·śeh ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·’eṯ- haš·šə·lā·mîm lə·ḵap·pêr bə·‘aḏ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And it shall be the prince’s [part] [to provide] the burnt offerings grain offerings and drink offerings for the feasts New Moons and Sabbaths for all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel He will provide - the sin offerings - grain offerings - burnt offerings - and peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel

verses.original: כֹּה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אָמַר֮ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ תִּקַּ֥ח פַּר־ בֶּן־ בָּקָ֖ר תָּמִ֑ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֖ אֶת־ הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·ri·šō·wn tiq·qaḥ par- ben- bā·qār tā·mîm wə·ḥiṭ·ṭê·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·miq·dāš
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says On the first day - of the first month you are to take a young bull . . . . . . without blemish and purify - the sanctuary

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלָקַ֨ח מִדַּ֣ם הַחַטָּ֗את וְנָתַן֙ אֶל־ מְזוּזַ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת וְאֶל־ אַרְבַּ֛ע פִּנּ֥וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֖ה לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעַ֨ל־ מְזוּזַ֔ת שַׁ֖עַר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃ הֶחָצֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ mid·dam ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·nā·ṯan ’el- mə·zū·zaṯ hab·ba·yiṯ wə·’el- ’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ hā·‘ă·zā·rāh lam·miz·bê·aḥ wə·‘al- mə·zū·zaṯ ša·‘ar hap·pə·nî·mîṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr
verses.literal: And the priest is to take some of the blood from the sin offering and put [it] on the doorposts of the temple on the four corners of the ledge of the altar and on the gateposts . . . of the inner court

verses.original: תַּֽעֲשֶׂה֙ וְכֵ֤ן בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה בַחֹ֔דֶשׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ שֹׁגֶ֖ה וּמִפֶּ֑תִי וְכִפַּרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śeh wə·ḵên bə·šiḇ·‘āh ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš mê·’îš šō·ḡeh ū·mip·pe·ṯî wə·ḵip·par·tem ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: You must do the same thing on the seventh day of the month for anyone who strays unintentionally or in ignorance In this way you will make atonement - for the temple

verses.original: בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּ֠רִאשׁוֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַפָּ֑סַח חָ֕ג שְׁבֻע֣וֹת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·ri·šō·wn yih·yeh lā·ḵem hap·pā·saḥ ḥāḡ šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ yā·mîm maṣ·ṣō·wṯ yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: On the fourteenth . . . day - of the first month you are to observe the Passover a feast of seven days during which unleavened bread shall be eaten

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם הַנָּשִׂיא֙ וְעָשָׂ֤ה פַּ֖ר חַטָּֽאת׃ בַּעֲד֕וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm han·nā·śî wə·‘ā·śāh par ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ba·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: On that day the prince shall provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land

verses.original: לַיּֽוֹם׃ וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵֽי־ הֶחָ֜ג יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת פָּ֠רִים וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֵילִ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ עוֹלָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה לַיּ֔וֹם שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַיָּמִ֑ים שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים וְחַטָּ֕את
verses.transliteration: lay·yō·wm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ yə·mê- he·ḥāḡ ya·‘ă·śeh šiḇ·‘aṯ pā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ê·lîm tə·mî·mim ‘ō·w·lāh Yah·weh lay·yō·wm šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm śə·‘îr ‘iz·zîm wə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Each day during the seven days of the feast he shall provide seven bulls and seven rams without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD - - - along with a male goat . . . for a sin offering

verses.original: יַֽעֲשֶׂ֑ה וּמִנְחָ֗ה אֵיפָ֥ה לַפָּ֛ר וְאֵיפָ֥ה לָאַ֖יִל הִ֥ין וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·śeh ū·min·ḥāh ’ê·p̄āh lap·pār wə·’ê·p̄āh lā·’a·yil hîn wə·še·men lā·’ê·p̄āh
verses.literal: He shall also provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah [of grain]

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים בֶּחָ֔ג בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֡י לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָאֵ֖לֶּה כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּעֹלָ֔ה וְכַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְכַשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm be·ḥāḡ ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm baš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš ya·‘ă·śeh ḵā·’êl·leh ka·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ kā·‘ō·lāh wə·ḵam·min·ḥāh wə·ḵaš·šā·men
verses.literal: During the seven days of the feast that begins on the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month he is to make the same provision . . . for sin offerings burnt offerings grain offerings and oil
